label: b2-adapt-long-20261123
question: On the B2 production tree, in a Pi-shaped tool-loop session at 32K-100K context, does --adapt-every 2 make decode windows at least 4% cheaper?
follows: plans/B2_ADAPT_PROBE_20261123.md (gate task set, prompts all below 32K: NO_GAIN); its 4K-32K bucket gave a post-hoc signal (22.40 -> 20.16 ms per window, CPU entries 3.57 -> 2.44)

workload.requests: one per assistant message k: messages[:k]; 120 in all (A 71, B 49)
workload.body: model, messages, tools = pisim TOOLS, max_tokens 16384, stream false, seed 20261123 + request index (0-based)
workload.history: fixed: recorded messages, never the arm's own replies; replies are measured and discarded
workload.estimate_method: A prompts as recorded; B prompts = A last prompt + A last completion (61806) + B prompt - 506
limits: fixed history makes the engine re-read the recorded reply each step (hundreds to a few thousand tokens), Pi reuses its own
pisim system prompt about 800 tokens and 4 tools; no streaming, no NGINX; one session, no switching

design: ABBA, each run a fresh engine on the production tree and config with production stopped, production restored between runs, Pi idle; no other values swept

metrics.primary: per run: decode ms per verify window, weighted by windows, over all requests with prompt >= 32768 (window_stats over those requests); per arm: mean of its two runs
secondary: ms_win in 32K-64K, >=64K and the <32K warm-up part
reach_ms, cpu_ms, cpu_entries, swaps, adapt_join, overlap wait (mechanism)

rules.aa: AA = |C0a - C0b| / mean(C0a, C0b) on the primary
rules.noisy: AA > 5%: NOISY -> INCONCLUSIVE, no adoption, no extra runs under this preregistration
rules.pass: mean(L1) <= mean(C0) x (1 - max(4%, 2 x AA)) AND max(L1a, L1b) < min(C0a, C0b) AND >=32K decode tok/s mean(L1) > mean(C0) AND |tok_win mean(L1)/mean(C0) - 1| <= 5%
rules.inconclusive: tok_win check fails: INCONCLUSIVE (text confound), not a pass
validity: engine started line has --adapt-every 2 in L runs and not in C runs
all 120 requests return without error and the engine log holds 120 requests, aligned in order
one rerun at most for an infrastructure failure; failed runs are kept
swap counts are reported, not used for validity (the previous probe showed min-gain caps them)
rules.quality: not judged in this stage (no grading, text not comparable)

outcomes.pass: stage 2: upgrade_gate.py probe b2-adapt-long-20261123 --arg adapt-every=2 without --limit (305 tasks, about 2 h): quality_gate NONINFERIORITY_ESTABLISHED (margin 5%, paired with stored b2) and full-arm decode tok/s not more than 2% below b2; then a production config change (add --adapt-every 2 to args) only with the user's confirmation, backup and rollback; afterwards real Pi >=32K ms per window from prodlog, observed, not judged
outcomes.no_pass: --adapt-every on long context is NO_GAIN too; closed in the no-repeat ledger
outcomes.noisy_or_inconclusive: recorded, not adopted; a retest needs a new preregistration and the noise source first

verdicts computed mechanically by a frozen evaluation script with these rules
